speaker: Mr Seah Kian Peng (Marine Parade)
text: Mr Charles Chong has been a Member of Parliament since 1988.

speaker: Mr Seah Kian Peng (Marine Parade)
text: I think this makes him the longest serving and the most experienced backbencher.

speaker: Mr Seah Kian Peng (Marine Parade)
text: He has sat on Select Committees and has led various Government Parliamentary Committees.

speaker: Mr Seah Kian Peng (Marine Parade)
text: I had the privilege of working with and being seated next to Mr Charles Chong during the last Parliament session.

speaker: Mr Seah Kian Peng (Marine Parade)
text: As for Mr Lim Biow Chuan, he was, like me, elected to Parliament in 2006.

speaker: Mr Seah Kian Peng (Marine Parade)
text: He has participated in the work of the various parliamentary committees and parliamentary friendship and regional groups.
